title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Brainstorm Force…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in Brainstorm Force Spectra ultimate-addons-for-gutenberg affecting versions up to 2.20.5. This vulnerability allows improper neutralization of input during web page generation, potentially enabling attackers to execute malicious scripts in the context of the affected web application. The issue is rated with a high severity CVSS score of 7.1.
